name: PSGB Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for work of direct benefit to primate conservation, such as threat reduction, surveys, compensation schemes and conservation education. A linked Born Free grant targets range-state nationals working in the field.

calls.label: March and November rounds
calls.recurring: Deadlines fall on 1 March and 1 November each year.

status.quote: Grant deadlines will fall take place twice per year on March 1st and November 1st.

recurring.quote: Grant deadlines will fall take place twice per year on March 1st and November 1st.

access.quote: All applications should be written in English and submitted directly to the Convenor

window.quote: Grant deadlines will fall take place twice per year on March 1st and November 1st.

amount.quote: These are awards, typically not exceeding £1,250, to assist work of direct benefit to primate conservation and primate conservation education.

applicant_types.quote: PSGB Grants are open to PSGB members and to primate range state nationals who are not members.
